zh: 对长度为 i+1 的前缀整体加减 1，只会改变 a[i] 与 a[i+1] 的差，其它相邻差都不变。
把数组看成差分 a[i]−a[i+1]，最后一项看作 a[n−1] 与 0 的差；全部归零等价于所有差分都为 0，而每次操作只能让一个差分变化 1。
答案为 |a[n−1]| 加上所有 |a[i]−a[i+1]| 之和，一次扫描累加；结果可达 2×10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: Adding or subtracting 1 on the prefix of length i+1 changes only the difference between a[i] and a[i+1]; every other adjacent difference stays the same.
View the array as the differences a[i]-a[i+1], with the last term being a[n-1] minus 0; making everything zero means making every difference 0, and each operation changes exactly one difference by 1.
The answer is |a[n-1]| plus the sum of all |a[i]-a[i+1]|, accumulated in one pass; it can reach 2*10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The answer is the absolute value of the last element plus the absolute value of every adjacent difference.

## Proof of correctness

Turn the array into differences b[i]=a[i]−a[i+1], with the last b[n−1]=a[n−1]. An operation on the prefix of length i+1 changes only b[i] by ±1 and leaves the other differences unchanged, so each difference needs at least its absolute value in operations; eliminating each difference independently attains exactly the total lower bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) excluding the input.
